hello.speaker: SECRETARY
hello.text: Hello? ...Who is this, at this hour?

choices.text: Sahab, it's Raghu, the night watchman. Sorry to call so late.

knows.speaker: SECRETARY
knows.text: Raghu. I know it's you. Speak.

report.speaker: RAGHU
report.text: Mr. Deshmukh from 4B went out at 3:12. He hasn't come back. And the intercom from 4B...

promised.speaker: SECRETARY
promised.text: You let him out? Kishan said the same thing. Kishan also kept a gate open.

empty.speaker: SECRETARY
empty.text: Raghu, 4B has been empty for eight months. Deshmukh-ji left in July.

choices.text: But I saw him. On the CCTV.
Mrs. Iyer says someone's up on the D wing terrace.

recording.speaker: SECRETARY
recording.text: Is it recording now? The camera?

intercom.speaker: SECRETARY
intercom.text: Nobody. That line is dead. I had it cut in August.

iyer.speaker: SECRETARY
iyer.text: Mrs. Iyer has called me about that light every night since July.
